# GrowthBook Reconnect with Extra Space
Date: 2026-08-25 | Duration: 46m

## Summary
The team discussed progress on fixing Visual Editor bugs, which are crucial for enterprise clients like Block and PepsiCo, while also highlighting stable advancements in experiment implementation. Testing is ongoing, with a focus on AI capabilities, including a new agent for test analysis, and plans for a learnings tab to grade experiments. Additional details covered included the mechanics of experiment bucketing using hash algorithms to ensure consistent user exposure, and the introduction of namespaces to avoid user overlap. The session also addressed data infrastructure related to experiment reporting and metric management, emphasizing the need for accurate data collection. Experiment results interpretation using Bayesian statistics was explained, alongside the role of feature flags in managing app behaviors based on experiments. The meeting concluded with plans for ongoing support and enablement sessions due to incomplete data connections.

## Keywords
Visual Editor, Experiment Bucketing, Feature Flags, AI Analysis, Metrics, Namespaces

## Action Items

Ensure AI agent features are enabled for Extra Space if desired to assist with test analysis (05:16)
Deliver recorded training session and enablement deck post-meeting to support asynchronous learning and reference (44:12)

**Megan Loveland**
Investigate and provide screenshots or references for previously seen AI test analysis features to GrowthBook team for clarity and support (06:43)
Progress data warehouse connection setup for experiment metrics and notify GrowthBook team when ready for further training and support (43:16)

**Cary Rakin**
